def f(key,default): return key,default
class C: pass
c=C()
c.get=f
print(c.get(1,2))

d={}
fallback=[]
value=d.get('x',fallback)
fallback.append(7)
print(value is fallback,value)
d={'x':9}
print(d.get is d.get,d.get.__self__ is d)

def produce(d):
    yield d.get('x')
    yield d.get('y',7)
print(list(produce({'x':3})))
